name: docker-swarm-to-systemd
description: Source side of the systemd-dev-plugins migration set. Capture a Docker Swarm cluster (nodes, stacks, services, tasks, networks, volumes, secrets, configs) into a normalized, schema-validated inventory, and plan its migration onto systemd-native hosts: host mapping, networking after the overlay, secrets, storage, cutover runbooks with rollback. Rendering to a target (Quadlet, nspawn, portable services, plain units) is done by the sibling plugins that read the same inventory contract.

inventory_dir.title: Inventory directory
inventory_dir.description: Where captures, inventories, plans, and rendered units are written. Defaults to ./.swarm-migration inside the project. The sibling plugins read the same setting.
